summary: Canadian National Railway Co. filed a Form 6-K reporting a binding Memorandum of Understanding with Union Pacific in connection with Union Pacific’s proposed merger with Norfolk Southern. CN gains competitive access, acquires Norfolk Southern’s ownership interests in Kansas City Terminal Railway and Terminal Railroad Association of St. Louis, obtains overhead rights between Tuscola and East St. Louis, Illinois, and usage of Union Pacific’s Neff Yard. No financial terms, price per share, premium, or break fee were disclosed. The agreement is contingent on STB approval and closing of the merger. CN agreed not to oppose the merger. Watch for STB regulatory proceedings and potential conditions imposed on the merger.
